summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by three frontier vendors — OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google — whose models reach the vast majority of enterprise developers through cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Google Vertex AI. Open-weight models from Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba have surged in adoption thanks to dramatically lower costs and strong HuggingFace download numbers. Because many announced 2026 models (GPT-6, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4) cannot be confirmed as publicly available in the research data, this ranking conservatively reflects models with verifiable current availability and adoption.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely integrated LLM via the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal input

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Confirmed released February 17, 2026, matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API driving heavy enterprise and coding adoption.
models.best_for: Agentic coding and enterprise development workflows

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Context-window leader distributed natively through Google Vertex AI and tightly integrated with Google Cloud, giving strong enterprise reach.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost workhorse with a 1M token context via Vertex AI, popular for cost-sensitive production workloads.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Cheapest frontier-class reasoning model at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens with strong HuggingFace download numbers as an open-weight MoE model.
models.best_for: Reasoning-heavy and math-intensive tasks on a budget

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Widely downloaded open-weight general-purpose model delivering near-frontier performance at a fraction of proprietary costs.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and widely available via AWS Bedrock and Azure, making it a default for self-hosted enterprise deployments.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Low-latency, low-cost member of the Claude family available via Bedrock and Vertex AI, favored for high-volume agentic sub-tasks.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Leading European model with strong adoption through Azure AI and AWS Bedrock, favored by EU enterprises for data-sovereignty reasons.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments with data-sovereignty needs

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Top-performing open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong adoption across Asian markets.
